        cache_size_limit=None,
        cache_expiry_days=None,

        self.cache_expiry_days = cache_expiry_days

            "config_fingerprint": None,
            "entries": {},
        }

            return
        try:

                data = json.load(f)
            if not isinstance(data, dict) or data.get("format_version") != CACHE_FORMAT_VERSION:
                LOG.warning("Discarding incompatible cache file: %s", self.cache_file)
                return
            entries = data.get("entries", {})
            if not isinstance(entries, dict):
                LOG.warning("Discarding corrupted cache file: %s", self.cache_file)
                return
            self._data["config_fingerprint"] = data.get("config_fingerprint")
            self._data["entries"] = entries
        except (ValueError, OSError) as e:
            LOG.warning("Discarding corrupted cache file %s: %s", self.cache_file, e)
            return
